scripts.predev: npm run build -w @breadpilot/api && npm run build -w @breadpilot/web
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @breadpilot/api && npm run build -w @breadpilot/web
scripts.stage: npm run build:all && node scripts/stage.mjs && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs .stage
scripts.dist: npm run stage && electron-builder --publish never && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs release && node scripts/clean-release.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run stage && electron-builder --mac --publish never && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs release && node scripts/clean-release.mjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run stage && electron-builder --win --publish never && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs release && node scripts/clean-release.mjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run stage && electron-builder --linux --publish never && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs release && node scripts/clean-release.mjs
scripts.dist:dir: npm run stage && electron-builder --dir --publish never && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs release
